'''Twizzl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] covert [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. A [[Color/Legends|silver]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he spoke with a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] accent. Twizzl served on the GAG [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] during several engagements of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], including the [[Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Hapes]],<ref name="Tempest" /> the [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]], and the [[Battle of Gilatter VIII]].<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. he was present at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], where Solo ordered the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} crew to initiate an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] operation on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld&mdash;a decision that Twizzl strongly disapproved of. While the Wookiee Jedi [[Lowbacca]] launched a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] at the ship, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ben Skywalker]] tried to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Solo. Skywalker attacked just as Lowbacca's shadow bomb struck the bridge, resulting in Twizzl, by proximity, being fatally bisected by Skywalker's lightsaber.
